verdict.rationale: The pack offers only a vendor peak-clock figure (boost up to 5.0 GHz) and a vendor press headline calling the chip the "fastest". The story explicitly rejects a peak-GHz number on a slide as proof. No independent single-thread benchmark appears, and community comments note the absence of benchmarks and suggest waiting for independent reviews, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide
